en.quote: At present, there is no talk of that [a full mobilization].
en.head: Partial mobilisation followed eight days later.
en.body: Reporters had asked about full mobilisation, and Peskov answered about that moment. On 21 September 2022, Putin announced partial mobilisation; the Defence Ministry later reported that about 300,000 people were called up. This does not refute the answer about full mobilisation, but it shows how sharply the public picture changed within eight days.
